en_US.title: Scanner Stage Binding
en_US.scanner: Scanner stage: contact, partial contour, material read, behavior read, full dossier.
en_US.terminal: Scanner descriptions escalate with measured contact: shape, composition, movement, habitat, and threat behavior.
en_US.audio: A scan should sound like a diver found something, not like a lecturer arrived.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Every scanner entry is tied to a physical stage of discovery. The first pass can be uncertain; later passes add hard readings and observed behavior.
en_US.external_site: Scanner writing should feel like field instrumentation: brief, specific, and earned by getting close enough to risk the read.
en_US.field_note: Keep scanner strings bound to scan percent, biome context, and evidence markers.

en_US.title: Terminal Slot Chain
en_US.scanner: Local terminal slots detected: order log, maintenance note, safety line, redacted operator remark.
en_US.terminal: Terminals carry short operational records from the place they stand in. They do not dump history outside that slot.
en_US.audio: A station terminal remembers what the crew typed there, not a distant narrator's explanation.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Terminal text is constrained by preserved slots and local operator context. A pump room gives work orders; a control room gives authority and failure records.
en_US.external_site: Terminal copy is short, physical, and local. It should read like a preserved system message or human note found in its original place.
en_US.field_note: Terminal rows bind to authored slot IDs, preserved text rows, and POI context.
